description: Checks availability and price for a domain, or for a bare name across a set of TLDs. Free and needs no account. Use it once the user wants their finished draft on a real address. A refused or unchecked domain ending carries `reason` and a plain `reason_text`: unsupported or price_unavailable mean we do not sell that ending right now; lookup_failed or cap_reached mean it was NOT checked, so search again, and never tell the customer we do not sell it.

limit.description: Max number of results to return (default: all, max 25).

query.description: A full domain (name.tld) or a bare name to check across TLDs.

tlds.description: Comma-separated TLDs to check a bare name against, e.g. "com,io". Ignored when query is a full domain.

name: domain_search
title: Domain search
